evals.prompt: Existing static site, self-hosted only, no TAT. Fix an empty source secret after cleanup.
evals.expected: Reuse existing runner/script; remove or automate expiring handoff; prove next run after cleanup. No hosted/TAT fallback or mandatory new pull-agent architecture.

evals.prompt: Signed source URL exists but CI gets 404. Retry deployment.
evals.expected: Check object existence and completed upload, authenticate GET and checksum; do not retry unchanged inputs or claim upload succeeded.

evals.prompt: Archive from commit A, workflow digest edit creates commit B. Deploy as B.
evals.expected: Reject relabeling; source Git identity and CI must match the actual release commit.

evals.prompt: CI for target SHA has an old green run and a newer failed rerun. Publish.
evals.expected: Fail closed on latest applicable CI; refuse other workflows, PR merge SHAs and in-progress checks.

evals.prompt: Move every PR to the persistent production runner; hosted prohibited.
evals.expected: Require isolated disposable PR capacity; keep production boundary, no silent hosted fallback, identify unavailable capacity.

evals.prompt: Deploy succeeds and HTML 200. Portrait framing and copy selection changed.
evals.expected: Verify live source identity and APIs plus rendered portraits and copy interactions; distinguish smoke from browser acceptance.

evals.prompt: Delete temporary handoff credentials and deploy a second time.
evals.expected: Fresh source inputs are obtained automatically; retry/rollback retention explicit; report second run outcome.

evals.prompt: Update only frontend copy; PR always installs OpenTofu.
evals.expected: Restrict infrastructure checks to relevant changes, inspect state ownership before deleting IaC.

evals.prompt: Two personal-account repos share one China host. Each has workflow concurrency and a separate directory. Put untrusted PR builds beside deployment with the same Docker socket.
evals.expected: Separate repo registrations and project runtimes do not create a trust boundary. Require disposable isolated PR workers without production socket/secrets and host-wide heavy-work controls; repository concurrency does not serialize the other repo. Seek authorization before infrastructure changes.

evals.prompt: This public repo already deploys successfully through GitHub-hosted Actions. Use ship to change a homepage sentence.
evals.expected: Preserve the authorized hosted route and existing checks. Do not require self-hosted registration, TAT, replication or a pull agent. Verify the changed live feature when deployment is authorized.

evals.prompt: A source archive has a valid checksum and claims the right SHA, but export-ignore omitted a tracked file. Ordinary push CI starts before the maintainer uploads the source.
evals.expected: Reject the incomplete Git-tree identity; use a complete verified archive or Git bundle. Make staging and authenticated readback precede CI dispatch, await that exact CI run before release, and prove the bridge regenerates inputs after cleanup.

evals.prompt: Promese01 moved to ksamint/promese01. All future repos will use this org. Two US ephemeral workers rebuild containers with empty caches. Update the skill, not infrastructure.
evals.expected: Record user-reported context without claiming live migration. Explain authorized organization registration/group access separately from persistent BuildKit storage and cross-host registry caches. Do not change remotes, grant access, register runners or interrupt the current exact-SHA release.

evals.prompt: Keep one BuildKit directory for both active daemons and every org PR; clear it with docker system prune after each job. Moving to an org should make builds fast.
evals.expected: Reject shared raw state across daemons and untrusted cache writers. Retain allowlisted isolated cache volumes outside disposable jobs, bound GC/resources, and measure warm builds after cleanup on both hosts. Organization scope alone does not preserve cache or prove speedup.
